answer.book: Bartholomaei Keckermanni, Systema systematum, tomus I (1613): a printed volume of seven works (Praecognita logica, Systema logicum maius and its second part, Systema logicum minus, Systema rhetoricum, Introductio ad eloquentiam, Rhetorica ecclesiastica), each divided into books, chapters and sections.
